proposal.expected_benefit: This integration will prevent contradictions between audit status and compliance decisions, ensuring robust control implementation and reducing the risk of consensus divergence and system instability.
proposal.problem: The mitigation strategies do not fully address the contradiction between audit status and compliance decisions, which could lead to further instability.
proposal.proposed_change: Integrate audit and compliance enforcement into a unified framework to ensure that audit requirements are non-negotiable and compliance decisions are explicitly tied to audit outcomes. This includes implementing a centralized audit-compliance dashboard that provides real-time visibility and enforces strict gates for both audit and compliance actions.
proposal.title: Reinforce Audit-Compliance Integration
